Settlements: the capital, aimag centres and soum centres

Source: R/layers-vector.R
mn_settlements.Rd

Points for Ulaanbaatar, the 21 aimag centres and the soum centres, handy for labelling maps. Locations come from Wikidata; a few soums without coordinates there use a point inside the soum (see location_source).

Usage

mn_settlements(
  type = c("capital", "aimag_centre", "soum_centre"),
  within = NULL,
  lang = NULL,
  crs = NULL
)

Arguments

type

Which settlements to return: any of "capital", "aimag_centre" and "soum_centre". By default, all.

within

Keep only settlements inside these places (names or codes).

lang

Language of the name column: "en" (English, as in NSO tables), "mn" (Cyrillic) or "mns" (Latin with diacritics, MNS 5217). Defaults to getOption("mongolmaps.lang", "en").

crs

Coordinate reference system of the result. NULL (default) keeps longitude/latitude (EPSG:4326). Use "albers", "lcc" or "utm" for a projection suited to Mongolia (see mn_crs()), or any value accepted by sf::st_crs().

Value

An sf tibble of points with columns admin_pcode (the aimag or soum the settlement is the centre of), soum_pcode, aimag_pcode, type, name, name_en, name_mn, name_mns and location_source.

See also

Other thematic layers: mn_neighbours(), mn_protected_areas(), mn_roads()

Examples

mn_settlements(type = c("capital", "aimag_centre"))
#> Simple feature collection with 22 features and 9 fields
#> Geometry type: POINT
#> Dimension:     XY
#> Bounding box:  xmin: 89.96321 ymin: 43.57 xmax: 114.5228 ymax: 50.36529
#> Geodetic CRS:  WGS 84
#> # A tibble: 22 × 10
#>    admin_pcode soum_pcode aimag_pcode type        name  name_en name_mn name_mns
